source.version: Undated working paper; no printed version or date. Citation record identifies arXiv:2405.17924v1, submitted 2024-05-28. Local SHA-256 matches the citation record. Latest SSRN revision unverified.
source.supplement_used: In-PDF Appendix A, Table 1 (PDF p. 34); Appendix B, Tables 1-4 and 6 (PDF pp. 37-40 and 42). External OSF supplement unavailable.

studies.label: Experiment I (teams: human-only vs single-AI vs multiple-AI)
studies.cluster_se_treatment: Teams were randomized to AI conditions (PDF p. 9). Regressions analyze repeated team-task outputs and report robust SEs without stating team clustering (PDF pp. 37-39, Appendix B, Tables 1-3). Bayesian models have no reported team random effects (PDF p. 40). Cluster counts are analyzed teams printed in Appendix A, Table 1 (PDF p. 34), not people.

counts_source.locator: PDF p. 8, Section 2.1 (cohort); PDF p. 9, Section 2.1 (randomized headcounts); PDF p. 34 (unnumbered), Appendix A, Table 1 (team-count headings)
counts_source.quote: 435 working professionals ... 142 participants were assigned to the human-only team, 150 to the single-AI team, and 143 to the multiple-AI team conditions. ... Human-Only Team (N=42) Single-AI Team (N=41) Multiple-AI Team (N=39)

arms.name: Human-only team
arms.description: Team worked without AI on analyzed outputs. A single ChatGPT4.0 touchpoint was offered after submission for refinement, but refinement effects were excluded (PDF p. 9, footnote 4).

arms.name: Single-AI team
arms.description: Team received a single shared ChatGPT4.0 touchpoint (PDF p. 9, Section 2.1).

arms.name: Multiple-AI team
arms.description: Team received as many ChatGPT4.0 touchpoints as members (PDF p. 9, Section 2.1).

studies.task: Each team wrote articles about college students’ job hunting and career development and developed a digital transformation strategy for a traditional retail chain (PDF pp. 9-10).

ai_tool.name: ChatGPT4.0
ai_tool.locator: PDF p. 9, Section 2.1, experimental conditions; PDF p. 10, interaction logs. Model release year is not printed.

preregistration.where: PDF p. 4, footnote 1: https://osf.io/5su8c/?view_only=24f9efec395c4581b880e7773792d23d. Python urllib request failed with WinError 10013; contents unverified.

estimates.question: with_ai
estimates.measure_detail: Six independent online-panel judges rated each team-task output, blind to hypotheses and conditions, on a scale from one to ten (PDF p. 10, Section 2.1). Analysis uses output scores.

regression.model: OLS on team-task outputs; task fixed effects and standardized baseline team age, gender, education, IQ, prior AI use, size and familiarity. Human-only reference for AI-versus-control; single-AI reference for AI-design.

estimates.notes: The randomized unit is the team. Each team contributes repeated task outputs; robust SEs are reported without team clustering or team random effects. SE basis is output. Printed regression N is n_units, not people. Analyzed headcounts are unreported. Coefficients are in raw rating-scale units: only control variables were standardized (PDF pp. 10-11). No combined-AI descriptive mean or SD is printed; neither was computed. Confidence-interval endpoints are only graphical in Figure 3 (PDF p. 28); none were read from the figure. Overall quality is coded usefulness, not overall creativity.

sources.locator: PDF p. 34 (unnumbered), Appendix A, Table 1, Task1, Overall row; columns Human-Only, Single-AI, Multiple-AI

estimates.notes: Full-sample task-specific arm descriptives. Every team completed both tasks (PDF pp. 10-11), so these records overlap the pooled-task estimates. Each task has one output per team. No task-specific contrast SE, test, p-value or interval is printed. No differences, pooled summaries, output counts or people counts were calculated. Team counts and pooled-task output counts are printed, but not the output total for this task-specific two-arm contrast; n_units remains null. SDs describe team-task outputs, not individual participant scores. Overall quality is coded usefulness.

not_extracted.reason: Figure 5 shows rating-score distributions without printed numerical density/interval endpoints (PDF p. 30). These concern the extracted ratings, not similarity/diversity of different people’s output content. No values were estimated from the graph.

not_extracted.what: Performance contrasts controlling or matching on task completion time, including AI-team versus human-only-team coefficients
not_extracted.reason: Completion time was measured after assignment; conditioning/matching on it is excluded even where target comparisons reuse randomized team arms (PDF pp. 18-19, Section 3.2.6). Individual-versus-team contrasts are additionally nonrandom.
Authors exclude refinement effects from analysis (PDF p. 9, footnote 4). No eligible delayed/unassisted or refinement effect is reported.

open_items: Exact analyzed people counts for Experiment I overall, by arm and by contrast are not separately printed. Randomized headcounts, team counts and output counts were not substituted for analyzed people counts.
No participant-level outcome SDs or team-level SDs of the average across tasks are printed. Appendix A SDs are across team-task outputs. No combined-AI descriptive means/SDs are printed.
No team/participant clustering is stated for output-level robust SEs or Bayesian models. Independent randomized-team precision for pooled-task contrasts is not established.
Appendix A prints means/SDs by task but no task-specific pairwise SEs, tests, intervals or combined output totals for each pairwise contrast. Counts were not calculated.

Bayesian multiple-versus-single-AI means and intervals disagree between PDF p. 13 and Appendix B, Table 4, PDF p. 40. Both versions are separately recorded; author clarification is needed before choosing between them.

Both named OSF supplement and preregistration requests failed with WinError 10013 using Python urllib and User-Agent atlas-screening/0.1. External statistics and preregistered outcome priority remain unverified.
The paper does not state the study country or print the model release year; neither was inferred from affiliation, model identity or cited papers.
The citation record confirms the local arXiv version, but not chronology relative to an inaccessible SSRN revision.
Whether Experiment II individuals previously participated in Experiment I is unstated. Its team comparators reuse Experiment I; no additional unique-person total is inferred.
notes: Extraction A, 2026-10-11. Read the entire markdown in order, including references and appendices, and extracted PDF text for every cited page. Table rows were transcribed from the PDF; quotes preserve decimal precision. No effect sizes, differences, pooled descriptors, participant counts or graphical values were computed. All estimates answer with_ai. Overall quality is usefulness under the codebook. Task-specific descriptors are full-sample repeated-task outcomes, not subgroup analyses. Pooled-task OLS regressions are the main summary specifications. Bayesian text/table records are conflicting versions of the same contrast, not independent evidence. Expanded-model OLS records retain only comparisons between original randomized Experiment I team arms; individual-versus-team contrasts remain excluded. No other paper sharing participants is identified in the screening form; within-paper reuse and unknown individual/team-cohort overlap are documented. No primary outcome, across-people content-diversity outcome or eligible after-AI outcome is reported. Locators are one-based PDF pages; appendix and figure pages have no printed page numbers.
